name: PM-KISAN Grievance API Attributes
privacy_notes: applicantId is marked writeOnly. It carries the farmer's PM-KISAN registration number, travels inbound only, and is never echoed in a response, written to a log, attached to a trace, or included in an error body.

The upstream status record also returns the farmer's name, father's name, gender, mobile number and full address. None of it is modelled or emitted; an adapter must drop these fields rather than pass them through resourceAttributes.
grievanceDescription is free text written by a farmer and may contain personal details the schema cannot constrain. It is returned verbatim on a case read.
The portal payload is carried inside an encrypted envelope. A decryption failure must not log the ciphertext.
